  {"task_id":"obj-p7-3","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,0,0,0,0,9],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Colour-3 objects with zero holes become 8: the first demonstration's L and the third's cross. The colour-3 ring with one hole stays 3; colours 1 and 2 stay unchanged."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p1-1","params":{"prop":[0,9,0,0,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Every demonstrated object has zero holes and becomes 5, including the third demonstration's singleton, L, line, and solid rectangles."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p1-2","params":{"prop":[0,9,0,0,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Zero-hole objects all become 8, including the first demonstration's cross, line, and singleton and the second's solid squares."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p4-2","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,0,9,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Size ranks 0, 1, and 2 become 9, 7, and 8. Demonstration one orders sizes 9, 4, 3; demonstration two orders 9, 3, 2; the smallest singleton remains unchanged."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p4-0","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,0,9,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"The largest object becomes 6 in every demonstration. In demonstration three, size 3 has rank 3 and becomes 9, while size 2 has rank 4 and becomes 8; demonstration one's singleton also has rank 4 and becomes 8."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p6-2","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,0,0,0,9,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Both border-touching and interior objects become 6, including demonstration one's top-border ring and interior cross and demonstration three's interior ring."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p3-2","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,9,0,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Bounding-box widths 1 and 2 become 7, as shown by vertical lines, the L, and the 2-by-2 square. Width-3 rings, crosses, and rectangles become 6."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p6-0","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,0,0,0,9,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Border-touching objects become 7 and interior objects become 9: demonstration one's left-border ring becomes 7 while its interior square and pair become 9."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p7-2","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,0,0,0,0,9],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"The colour-2 ring with one hole becomes 8, and the colour-3 ring with one hole becomes 9. Hole-free objects of those colours stay unchanged."},
  {"task_id":"obj-p4-1","params":{"prop":[0,0,0,0,9,0,0,0],"bg":[9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},"rationale":"Ranks 1, 3, and 4 become 8: demonstration one's sizes 8, 3, and 2. Rank-0 and rank-2 objects stay unchanged; demonstration three's tied size-3 objects both have rank 1 and become 8."}
]
